correctness.rationale: The center is spanned by three class sums over every field; explicit group multiplication gives three independent brackets, proving Λ²(A/Z)→W is an isomorphism. Every 3D bivector is decomposable, giving zero wedge fiber q^4+q^3-q and each nonzero wedge fiber |SL2(q)|=q(q²−1). The central lifts multiply counts by q^6. Direct exhaustive verification for q=2,3,4 independently builds group multiplication and checks all q^12 input pairs and output fibers.

The public Kronecker path-algebra research record and generalized-commutator record were available only as detailed summaries rather than full paper text.

A broader unlocated theorem or tabulation for the additive commutator map of 2-by-2 matrix algebras could imply the characteristic-not-2,3 cases; the all-field group-algebra proof remains explicit and modularly uniform.
Research-index retrieval and web searches cannot establish publication priority.

value.rationale: A complete fixed-target distribution for the associative commutator map is a natural refinement of commuting probability, revealing whether all nonzero commutator outputs arise equally often. The identification of the quotient commutator map with exterior multiplication explains uniformity over an infinite field family, including modular characteristics 2 and 3 where usual semisimple reduction fails. This is a complete structural classification of the word-map fibers for the natural six-dimensional group ring, not an arbitrary finite table.
